ABBREVIATE: सम्-क्षिपति (क्षिप् c. 6.): v. To
contract, shorten.

ABROAD (adv.):
I In a foreign country:
(1) विदेशे;
(2) देशान्तरे।
II To a foreign
country:
(1) विदेशं;
(2) देशान्तरम्।
III Not
at home बहिस्।
IV Widely: q. v.:
spread-
ing his rays far a.
दूरप्रसारितकरः, K.

ABROAD, LIVE:
(1) प्रवसति (वस्, c. 1.);
(2) विदेशे वसति etc.
One who is, or, is living
a.
प्रोषितः (ता, तं).
ABROGATE, ABROGATION: v. To repeal, etc.

ABRUPT (adj.):
I Steep, rugged: q. v.:
विषमः (मा, मं).
II Hasty, sudden: q. v.:
(1) आकस्मिकः (की, कं);
(2) अकाण्डः (ण्डा, ण्डं).
III Of style: no equiv.: *भग्नः (भग्ना,
 भग्नं).

ABRUPTNESS:
I Steepness: q. v. Haste,
Suddenness: q. v.
